audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was given to Graves and level 6 to Graves, with level 2 called 'Skill', while the page's own whys[1] and whys[4] say the opposite.
audit.why: The packet chart and the already-audited mirror both read Skill, Shen, Shen, Shen, Shen, Shen, Shen. Graves' four-bullet passive cannot pass through units, so a minion blanks most of level 1; and level 6 is Shen's, because Stand United is global and Collateral Damage is not.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1 and 4 flipped to Skill, Shen, Shen in matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Graves' stage and the full layer named Iceborn Gauntlet as the deciding spike.
audit.why: Stand United (200/180/160s) is map-wide; Collateral Damage is 1000 range on 100/80/60s. The level-6 spike belongs to Shen and it is a macro spike, not a duel spike.
audit.corrected: phases[4] flipped to Shen and its why rewritten around the global comparison.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two real errors. The page calls Graves' Q 'Buckshot' throughout — the ability is End of the Line, an explosive shell that detonates after 1 second or on terrain, not a close-range cone. And Smoke Screen is described as 'blinding' Shen's autos; it reduces sight range and slows on impact, it does not blind.
audit.why: Riot's own text: End of the Line 'fires an explosive shell that detonates after 1 second, or after colliding with terrain', 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s. Smoke Screen 'creates a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range'. Also, Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only, so End of the Line and Collateral Damage pass straight through the zone.
audit.corrected: Buckshot replaced with the real passive/Q behaviour and cooldown; Smoke Screen restated as sight reduction plus slow; Refuge scoped to attacks.

audit.why: Quickdraw is the right cooldown to track — 16/15/14/13/12s, and it is his only way out of the taunt.
suspectNames flagged 'Use Smoke Screen' and 'His Smoke Screen' — false positives on the name itself; the error was in what the ability does, handled under point 4.

edits.before: Q-empowered autos with the blade behind him win trades. Identify how Graves contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: His four bullets cannot pass through units — hold a minion in between and level 1 is a wash that he cannot win either.

edits.before: W spirit zone blanks his auto window. Only take the trade when Graves's Quickdraw is down.
edits.after: Refuge blanks his shotgun attacks. Trade when Quickdraw is down — 16s at rank 1.

edits.before: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy MAP — track every low ally. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Graves's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Stand United is global and Collateral Damage is not — every low ally is a 3v2 you can create, and Graves has no answer to it at all.

edits.before: Graves's Buckshot Q deals maximum damage at close range and Quickdraw is on a long cooldown at Level 1 — keep the spirit blade between you and him, do not step into the cone, and take only auto trades.
edits.after: Graves' shotgun passive fires four bullets that cannot pass through units — stand behind a minion and most of the burst is eaten. End of the Line is 13s at rank 1, so step up only after he spends it.

edits.before: Graves's Buckshot hits hardest at close range and his Quickdraw E is on a long cooldown — he can punish if Shen steps into range without a blade gap.
edits.after: His shotgun bullets cannot pass through units and End of the Line is 13s at rank 1 — hold a minion between you and he cannot punish your walk-up.

edits.before: Use W's spirit zone to blank Graves's point-blank Buckshot burst and force him to auto into a taunt
edits.after: Use Spirit's Refuge to blank his shotgun attacks — End of the Line still lands, so taunt him first

edits.before: Use Smoke Screen to blind Shen's Q-empowered autos and break the W-zone fight
edits.after: Drop Smoke Screen on you to cut your sight range and slow you out of the W zone

edits.before: Level 1 is the only window Graves genuinely contests — his Buckshot Q hits hardest when Shen walks into the close-range spread, and without E online Shen cannot taunt him into the spirit blade path. Keep the blade between you and Graves and auto him only when the point-blank cone misses. At Level 2 Shadow Dash comes online and the dynamic flips: Graves must use Quickdraw to sidestep your E, and the moment that dash is on cooldown your W-zone absorbs his autos while he eats Q magic damage and the Ki Barrier shield eats the rest. By Level 3 you have the full pattern — E-taunt on his Quickdraw cooldown, drop W between you, auto through his return damage — and Graves has no answer that does not burn his escape.
edits.after: Level 1 is the only window Graves genuinely contests — his shotgun passive fires four bullets that cannot pass through units, so hold a minion between you and most of the burst never arrives, and End of the Line is 13s at rank 1. Keep the blade between you and Graves and auto him only after he spends the shell. At Level 2 Shadow Dash comes online and the dynamic flips: Graves must use Quickdraw to sidestep your E, and the moment that dash is on cooldown your W-zone absorbs his attacks while he eats Q magic damage and the Ki Barrier shield eats the rest. By Level 3 you have the full pattern — E-taunt on his Quickdraw cooldown, drop W between you, auto through his return damage — and Graves has no answer that does not burn his escape.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are straightforward lane control: watch Quickdraw's cooldown visually, position the spirit blade toward Graves before engaging, and short-trade repeatedly to drain his reload time. His Smoke Screen is his only real disruption — if he drops it on you, walk out sideways rather than dashing in blind, because E-into-smoke means you eat full Buckshot without W-zone protection. Level 6 is where this matchup tips decisively: Stand United turns every allied tower dive, every bot-lane 2v2, every skirmish into a potential 3v2. Graves cannot match that threat and will eventually be forced to farm under tower while Shen shapes the map.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are straightforward lane control: watch Quickdraw's cooldown — 16s at rank 1 — position the spirit blade toward Graves before engaging, and short-trade repeatedly to drain his reload. Smoke Screen is his only real disruption: on a 26s cooldown at rank 1 it cuts your sight range and slows on impact, so walk out sideways rather than dashing in blind, and remember Refuge blocks his attacks but never End of the Line. Level 6 is where this matchup tips decisively: Stand United turns every allied tower dive, every bot-lane 2v2, every skirmish into a potential 3v2. Graves cannot match that threat and will be forced to farm under tower while Shen shapes the map.

notes: 'Buckshot' is a genuine fabricated/outdated ability name and it appeared in four places (whys[0], spikes[3], early, mid, wants.you[0]) — Graves' Q is End of the Line, a delayed explosive shell, not a close-range cone, so the positioning advice built on it was wrong as well as misnamed. The close-range danger is his passive shotgun attack, which is what I replaced it with. Smoke Screen also does not blind — it reduces sight range. Neither error was in suspectNames.
